entity.description:
Belluna was a fictional coastal village in California, United States; implied to lie along the coast of the Pacific Ocean. With a population of 27 employed primarily in fishing and agriculture, the tiny settlement consisted of several houses and a general store with a cafe and filling station. Nearby was Camp Heliotrope, a nudist resort, and the nearest motel, Casa Manana Motel, was located 12 miles south of Belluna. The location appeared in the James Bond comic strip, Trouble Spot, which ran in The Daily Express newspapers between December 28, 1971 and June 10, 1972.
